Money: Student Allowance.script: (function(){const d=check({type:'read-number',key:'currentDay'})||0;if(d<1){skip=true;return;}const r0=(d+29),y=Math.floor(r0/365);let r=r0%365,i=0;const ML=[31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31,31,28];while(r>=ML[i]){r-=ML[i];i++;}const mo=y*12+i;if(typeof storage.alM!=='number'){storage.alM=r===0?mo-1:mo;}if(mo<=storage.alM){skip=true;return;}const n=mo-storage.alM;storage.alM=mo;const T=JSON.stringify(check({type:'player-traits'})||'');if(!/U[.]A[.] (Hero Course|General Studies|Support Course|Management Course)/.test(T))return;const A={"Wealthy Family": 80000, "Hero Family": 30000, "Police Family": 20000, "Ordinary Family": 20000, "Family Business": 20000, "Grew Up Facing Prejudice": 20000, "Criminal Ties": 20000};let a=0;for(const k in A)if(T.indexOf(k)>=0){a=A[k];break;}if(a>0){effects.push({type:'item-add',item:'Yen',quantity:a*n});log('student allowance '+a+' x'+n);}})();
